# UN Human Rights Office (OHCHR)

> The Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights provides global human rights information, standards, mechanisms, country resources, and publications.

OHCHR serves governments, civil society, national human rights institutions, educators, journalists, and the public with authoritative resources on international human rights law, UN mechanisms, country situations, thematic issues, and practical implementation guidance.

## Core Human Rights Information
- [What are human rights?](https://www.ohchr.org/en/what-are-human-rights): Introductory overview of human rights principles, universality, and international protection.
- [Human rights overview](https://www.ohchr.org/en/what-are-human-rights): Foundational explanation of the human rights system and key concepts.
- [Universal Declaration of Human Rights](https://www.ohchr.org/en/human-rights/universal-declaration/translations/english): Full text of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights in English.
- [Human rights indicators](https://www.ohchr.org/en/resources/indicators): Resources on measuring and monitoring human rights implementation and outcomes.
- [Frequently asked questions on human rights](https://www.ohchr.org/en/what-are-human-rights/faqs-human-rights): Concise answers to common questions about rights and protections.

## Human Rights Topics
- [Human rights themes](https://www.ohchr.org/en/topic): Directory of thematic human rights issues covered by OHCHR.
- [Civil and political rights](https://www.ohchr.org/en/topic/civil-and-political-rights): Resources on freedoms, participation, justice, and protection from abuse.
- [Economic, social and cultural rights](https://www.ohchr.org/en/topic/economic-social-and-cultural-rights): Materials on housing, health, education, work, and social protection.
- [Equality and non-discrimination](https://www.ohchr.org/en/topic/equality-and-non-discrimination): Guidance on combating discrimination and promoting equal rights.
- [Development and living in dignity](https://www.ohchr.org/en/topic/development-and-living-dignity): Content on poverty, development, environment, and dignity-centered rights approaches.
- [Violence and insecurity](https://www.ohchr.org/en/topic/violence-and-insecurity): Information on torture, trafficking, conflict, and related protections.

## Countries and Regional Engagement
- [Countries](https://www.ohchr.org/en/countries): Country pages, field presences, and human rights situation information.
- [National institutions and regional mechanisms](https://www.ohchr.org/en/countries/nhri): Resources for national human rights institutions and regional human rights mechanisms.
- [Member States](https://www.ohchr.org/en/resources/member-states): Materials and tools tailored for UN Member States.
- [Field presences](https://www.ohchr.org/en/countries/field-presence): Overview of OHCHR offices and human rights field operations worldwide.
- [Human rights by region](https://www.ohchr.org/en/countries): Regional and country access points for OHCHR work and documentation.

## Human Rights Mechanisms
- [Human Rights Council](https://www.ohchr.org/en/hr-bodies/hrc/home): Information on the UN Human Rights Council and its work.
- [Treaty bodies](https://www.ohchr.org/en/treaty-bodies): Documentation and guidance on UN human rights treaty monitoring bodies.
- [Special procedures](https://www.ohchr.org/en/special-procedures-human-rights-council): Mandates, experts, and thematic or country-specific procedures.
- [Universal Periodic Review](https://www.ohchr.org/en/hr-bodies/upr/upr-main): Resources on the UPR process, documentation, and state reviews.
- [Complaint procedures](https://www.ohchr.org/en/hr-bodies/complaints-procedure): Information on submitting complaints under UN human rights procedures.
- [Commissions of inquiry and fact-finding missions](https://www.ohchr.org/en/hr-bodies/hrc/co-is-and-ffm): Access to investigative mechanisms established by the Human Rights Council.

## Resources for Audiences
- [Civil society](https://www.ohchr.org/en/resources/civil-society): Guidance and opportunities for civil society engagement with OHCHR mechanisms.
- [Educators](https://www.ohchr.org/en/resources/educators/human-rights-education-training): Human rights education and training materials for teachers and trainers.
- [Journalists / Media Centre](https://www.ohchr.org/en/media-centre): News, press releases, statements, and media resources.
- [Member States](https://www.ohchr.org/en/resources/member-states): Practical resources supporting state participation and implementation efforts.
- [National institutions and regional mechanisms](https://www.ohchr.org/en/countries/nhri): Tools and information for NHRIs and regional bodies.
- [Youth and students](https://www.ohchr.org/en/youth): Human rights information and engagement resources for young people.

## Databases and Knowledge Tools
- [Databases](https://www.ohchr.org/en/resources/databases): Entry point to OHCHR databases, indexes, and searchable tools.
- [Knowledge Gateway](https://knowledgegateway.ohchr.org/): Platform for implementation knowledge, good practices, and policy resources.
- [UN Treaty Body Database](https://tbinternet.ohchr.org/): Search treaty body documentation, concluding observations, and state reports.
- [Universal Human Rights Index](https://uhri.ohchr.org/): Search recommendations and observations from UN human rights mechanisms.
- [Jurisprudence database](https://juris.ohchr.org/): Database of decisions, views, and jurisprudence from treaty bodies.
- [Special procedures database](https://spcommreports.ohchr.org/): Search communications and reports from special procedures mandates.

## Publications and Library
- [Publications](https://www.ohchr.org/en/publications): Official OHCHR reports, manuals, fact sheets, and thematic publications.
- [Library](https://www.ohchr.org/en/library): Access to the UN Human Rights Library and research resources.
- [Fact sheets](https://www.ohchr.org/en/publications/fact-sheets): Short explanatory publications on specific human rights issues.
- [Training and education publications](https://www.ohchr.org/en/publications/training-and-education-publications): Manuals and educational materials for human rights learning.
- [Policy and methodological publications](https://www.ohchr.org/en/publications/policy-and-methodological-publications): Guidance documents on methods, indicators, and implementation practice.
- [Annual reports](https://www.ohchr.org/en/publications/annual-report): Annual reporting on OHCHR priorities, activities, and results.

## News, Statements, and Media
- [Media Centre](https://www.ohchr.org/en/media-centre): Central hub for press releases, briefings, and official statements.
- [News](https://www.ohchr.org/en/news): Latest OHCHR news and updates on human rights developments.
- [Press releases](https://www.ohchr.org/en/press-releases): Official press releases from OHCHR and UN human rights experts.
- [Statements and speeches](https://www.ohchr.org/en/statements-and-speeches): Public statements, speeches, and remarks by OHCHR leadership.
- [Events](https://www.ohchr.org/en/events): Upcoming and past events, observances, and human rights sessions.
- [Stories](https://www.ohchr.org/en/stories): Feature stories highlighting human rights issues and field impact.

## About OHCHR
- [About us](https://www.ohchr.org/en/about-us): Overview of OHCHR mandate, structure, and role within the UN system.
- [High Commissioner](https://www.ohchr.org/en/about-us/high-commissioner): Information about the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights.
- [Mandate](https://www.ohchr.org/en/about-us/mandate): Explanation of OHCHR’s mandate and institutional responsibilities.
- [Working with us](https://www.ohchr.org/en/about-us/working-us): Careers, internships, and opportunities to work with OHCHR.
- [Contact us](https://www.ohchr.org/en/contact-us): Contact information for OHCHR offices and inquiries.
- [Donors and funding](https://www.ohchr.org/en/about-us/donors-and-un-budget): Information on OHCHR funding and donor support.
